notice: Candidate test plan. It is not acceptance, not PM approval and not runtime permission. Results live in docs/evidence/R-04/evidence-candidate-index.json.

routing.requires: any Windows 10/11 machine with Windows PowerShell 5.1 and Python 3.11+; POSIX host optional for bootstrap.sh

safety: run in a fresh worktree outside the working checkout; tamper cases edit policy files and restore them
never pass -AutoInstall; no global npm install or uv sync
receipts and logs stay outside Git; publish digests only
do not edit scripts/bootstrap/** (R-07 #52 owns verifier changes)

cases.expected: exact ran/passed/failed/skipped counts and exit code recorded
cases.negativeCase: failure or missing python is recorded as failed/blocked, never as pass

cases.command: same discover command with ASCII checkout+interpreter, then only the interpreter path changed
cases.negativeCase: a control pass does not replace the PY-1 result

cases.expected: no global install/sync; verifier exit propagated unchanged
cases.negativeCase: nonzero verifier result (missing pi/uv) is preserved

cases.command: bootstrap.ps1 -MachineLabel local with PATH lacking python/py
bootstrap.ps1 -MachineLabel local with PATH lacking node/npm

cases.expected: exit 2 before scanning, nothing written outside docs/evidence, existing receipt unchanged
cases.negativeCase: path escape: parent, absolute, '..' inside evidence, outside evidence root, non-json, existing receipt, junction escape, backslash parent

cases.command: two verify_toolchain.py --write receipts around a one-byte AGENTS.md change (restored)
cases.expected: only the AGENTS.md policy hash differs
cases.negativeCase: policy hash mismatch; records whether the verifier itself fails on it

cases.command: compare R-04 and R-07 candidate write scopes from their work orders

acceptanceMapping.criterion: Python and native OS checks are separate and evidence-labeled.
Negative cases include nonzero, missing tool, path escape, policy hash mismatch.
No school PC/location/high-spec route or named owner exists.
R-07 verifier implementation is not silently overwritten.
